Class ContentLoader

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Content
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Provides a simple wrapper to load all types of Raylib resources and JSON strings.

Remarks

Resources and content refer to assets shipped with the game, such as textures, fonts, audio files, shaders, and similar files. Text-based data files (e.g. XML, JSON) included with the game can be loaded as strings using this class. For loading previously saved game data, use the ShapeFileManager class instead.

GetMacOsAppBundleResourcePath(string)

Resolves the full path to a resource file when running inside a macOS application bundle.

public static string GetMacOsAppBundleResourcePath(string relativePath)

Parameters

relativePath string

The relative path to the resource.

Returns

string

If running in a macOS .app bundle, returns the full path within the bundle's Resources directory. Otherwise, returns the original relativePath unchanged.

Remarks

In macOS .app bundles, the executable is located in Contents/MacOS/ while resources are in Contents/Resources/. This method handles the path conversion for proper resource loading in both development and deployed scenarios.

LoadFont(string, int, TextureFilter)

Loads a font from a file with the specified font size and texture filter.

public static Font LoadFont(string filePath, int fontSize = 100, TextureFilter textureFilter = TextureFilter.Trilinear)

Parameters

filePath string

The path to the font file.

fontSize int

The size of the font to load. Default is 100.

textureFilter TextureFilter

The texture filter to apply to the font texture. Default is Trilinear.

Returns

Font

The loaded Font object.

Examples

If all resources are in a Resources folder at the project root, the following paths would be valid:

  • "Resources/Fonts/font.ttf"
  • "Resources/Audio/Music/BackgroundMusic.mp3"
  • "Resources/Audio/Sounds/Jump.wav"
  • "Resources/Images/Background.png"

Remarks

Automatically resolves resource paths for macOS application bundles. By default, file paths should be relative to the executable's directory.

LoadFontsFromDirectory(string, int, TextureFilter, bool)

Loads all fonts from a directory and returns a dictionary mapping relative file paths to Font objects.

public static Dictionary<string, Font> LoadFontsFromDirectory(string directoryPath, int fontSize = 100, TextureFilter textureFilter = TextureFilter.Trilinear, bool recursive = false)

Parameters

directoryPath string

The directory path containing font files.

fontSize int

The size of the fonts to load. Default is 100.

textureFilter TextureFilter

The texture filter to apply to the font textures. Default is Trilinear.

recursive bool

Whether to search recursively in subdirectories. Default is false.

Returns

Dictionary<string, Font>

A dictionary mapping relative file paths to loaded Font objects.

Remarks

Only loads files with valid font extensions [".ttf", ".otf"]. The key is the relative path from the directory to the font file.

Parameters

filePath string

The path to the font file.

font Font

fontSize int

The size of the font to load. Default is 100.

textureFilter TextureFilter

Returns

bool

True if the font was loaded successfully; otherwise, false.

Valid extensions for Wave can be managed via AddValidFileExtension(ContentType, string), RemoveValidFileExtension(ContentType, string),and SetValidFileExtensions(ContentType, params string[]).
